key_insight: FiLSim uses a simplified GNN pipeline to learn graph similarity accurately at scales exceeding 150,000 nodes.
engineering_relevance: FiLSim offers a scalable learned alternative to computationally expensive exact graph similarity calculations, scoring all evaluated test pairs within seconds on a single GPU.
method: Use a simplified GNN-based framework for graph similarity learning.
Construct large-scale datasets through sequential graph editing with reliable graph edit distance labels.
Evaluate prediction performance and scalability against baseline methods.
evidence_signal: Across four benchmark and four newly created large-scale datasets, FiLSim remained accurate on graphs exceeding 150,000 nodes, where baselines ran out of memory or failed to learn.
watch_item: Performance on edit-generated datasets may not fully predict generalization to naturally occurring large graphs; hardware and workload details are needed to interpret runtime claims.
paper_title: Scaling Graph Similarity Learning with Graph Neural Networks
